justification.text: `↑(Erdos563.F n α) / Real.log ↑n` is the problem's ratio F(n, α)/log n whose limit c_α is asserted at `atTop`, and Real.log n = 0 only for n ∈ {0, 1}, which a limit along atTop never sees, so the denominator is positive wherever it matters.
